text.tspan: Share of 2-to-10-year-olds who are defined as stunted. Stunting is when a child is significantly shorter than the
average for their age. It is a consequence of poor nutrition or repeated infection.

tspan.tspan: Schneider et al. (2026). The decline of child stunting in 122 countries: a systematic review of child growth studies since the 19th
